name: Individual Placement and Support for Severe Mental Illness (SMI)
organisation: South West Yorkshire Partnership Teaching NHS Foundation Trust (SWYPFT)
whoFor: Adults in Kirklees with severe and complex mental health needs who receive support from secondary mental health services. We primarily support people who are unemployed, with some limited support available for those off sick, struggling at work or seeking a different role to improve their wellbeing.
eligibility: Currently receiving support from secondary care mental health services (Core, Enhanced or Early Intervention in Psychosis teams)
Committed to entering or remaining in paid employment
Primarily those unemployed but limited capacity for those in work and struggling, off sick, or in work and seeking a different role to improve wellbeing
exclusions: Mild to moderate mental health conditions
Only wants to look at voluntary work or education
Not currently under the care of secondary care mental health services
gate: Currently receiving support from secondary care mental health services (Core, Enhanced or Early Intervention in Psychosis teams)
Committed to entering or remaining in paid employment
Primarily those unemployed but limited capacity for those in work and struggling, off sick, or in work and seeking a different role to improve wellbeing
referralRoutes: Online self referral - electronic 'expression of interest' form under 'Referrals' on the service webpage

projects.name: Individual Placement and Support for Severe and Complex Mental Illness
projects.overview: ndividuals will receive personalised support from an Employment Specialist to identify suitable work, search and apply for roles, prepare for interviews and engage with employers. Support can also include benefits advice, disclosure and workplace adjustments, with ongoing support for both the individual and their employer once in work.
projects.area: Wherever the individual feels most comfortable, most typically within local community venues such as libraries, community centres as well as Trust host bases.
projects.duration: Time-unlimited support for as long as the person wishes and remains under the care of secondary mental health services

notes: Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals

coachNotes: If you are unsure whether a referral is suitable, please get in touch with the team. Simply email a brief outline of your query and your preferred contact details. We work closely with DWP colleagues, and some of our Employment Specialists regularly work from Jobcentres across Kirklees.
